  page_title: Purchase Request create
  roles:
  - Authenticated nonprivileged membership with required capability and limited project/site grants
  category: SECURITY_SCOPE
  severity: MEDIUM
  status: STATIC_CONFIRMED
  runtime_status: NOT_EXECUTED

      Cross-tenant exposure not tested.

    mutation or full document content access claimed.

  root_pattern_review: F-111 same-pattern static confirmation; original F-111 remains RUNTIME_VERIFIED_RESOLVED.
  recommendation: Separate bounded remediation authorization required; preserve domain-specific object authority
